utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Mara, I keep hearing about this repair drive—do you know what it's actually about?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It's a community event where we fix up the school grounds and equipment. It's been moved to Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, Sunday? I thought it was Saturday—glad I checked with you.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Vik, you're coming to the repair drive this Saturday, right? I've been spreading the word like wildfire—we're gonna fix up the whole block!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely! We're planning a neighborhood repair drive this weekend to fix up the community garden tools — it's going to be great!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Fantastic! I've got almost everyone on board. Do you think we'll need extra tools or should I ask around for donations?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I heard about it. Sounds like a good idea, but you know me—I'll probably roll in a bit late.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, Dane. I'll save a spot for your stuff. You know where to find me.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Appreciate it, Gus. I'll dig up something worth fixing and see you when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Oren, did Rosa check your toolbox for a socket set? I need it for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Socket set? Oh, I think I left that in the garage... did Rosa find it?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, she was going to check. Can you just grab it from the garage and bring it Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hana, are you really sure about this repair drive? I need some proof.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I've got the hex wrenches and screwdriver ready. Want to see them?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I mean, wrenches are fine, but have you actually seen the damage? Leo said something's jammed under the deck.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Cleo! I'm helping organize the repair drive this Saturday—do you know the exact start time?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, hi Faye! It's starting at 10 AM sharp. I've got a list of supplies ready.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, 10 AM works perfectly. I'll make sure to update the schedule and let everyone know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Actually, I heard it's been moved to Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on Elm Street.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, really? I must have gotten my wires crossed. Thanks for the update, Mina!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you know what kinds of things people are bringing to fix?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Hi Bo, good to see you. Just so you know, the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right, Sunday—thanks Pia, I’ll pencil that in then.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks Bo. I just want to make sure everyone knows, so we don't have folks showing up at my porch on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I'm all in for the repair drive. Got my wrenches ready and can help with setup too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, Sam! Maybe you can take a look at my wobbly chair while you're at it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, Ira, I can check that wobbly chair for you. Bring it by and I'll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: So, I hear the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, that's right. Sunday at the community center works better for me—more space and a set time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good, Sunday suits me better anyway. I'll bring my old lamp.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I thought it was this Saturday... or maybe last week. I can never keep track.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think it's this weekend. I'll be there, but I might not be much use.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: This weekend, right? I'll try to remember, but you know me—I'll probably show up a day late and empty-handed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rosa, did you hear the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I made that change myself! It's all set for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Well, you sure saved me from showing up at the wrong place—thanks for sorting that out!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Vik, I'm glad you're here. We're still organizing the tool inventory for the repair drive—could you help me sort through what we have?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course, Cleo! Sam was already telling me they're helping you sort tools tomorrow—I'll make sure to be there too to get everything ready for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh perfect, that's a relief! With you and Sam both on board, we'll have this inventory sorted in no time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hmm, I think it's this Saturday... or maybe it was last week? I really can't keep track.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that's a bit confusing. I hope it's this Saturday—I'd hate to miss it if it already happened!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, sorry, I'm terrible with dates. Let me check my phone... or was it on the community board?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I'll try to swing by if I get a minute. Thanks, Tess.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Wait, Sunday? Thought it was Saturday. Alright, I'll pencil it in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Eli, I've got my wrenches ready. What do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hold on, Sam. I heard the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center. Did you get that update?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, thanks for the heads up Eli! Sunday at the community center works for me. I'll still bring my wrenches.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Hana, any word on when that repair drive is starting? I've got a wobbly chair that's been driving me nuts.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'm not sure yet—Noah mentioned it might be Saturday, but I haven't confirmed. Let me double-check with them before we make any plans.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Saturday sounds promising—just let me know when it's official, my chair's getting wobblier by the day.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Mina, do you know if the repair drive is happening this Saturday? I need to sort out the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's actually moved to Sunday at the community center, not Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, thanks Mina — that changes everything. I'll start coordinating the Sunday slots right away.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I heard about it—sounds like a solid plan. I'll swing by, just probably after my morning coffee run.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Well, Dane, you'll want to get there early if you're hoping for a good spot—the truck's already on Elm Street, so things are moving faster than I expected.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Ah, I hear you Opal, but you know me—I'll still be the last one rolling in with my cup of joe.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I'm planning to bring my whole toolbox. Got a feeling we'll need plenty of screwdrivers and wrenches.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, they fixed a tractor? That's a whole different level of broken. You're sure about that?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, old Mr. Henderson's tractor. Took some elbow grease, but we got it running again. These drives can handle anything!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Jules! Have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? I'm getting the whole neighborhood together to pitch in!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I heard! I already mentioned it to Ira and Kira — Ira's got a wobbly chair, and Kira's a bit skeptical, but I think once it's happening, she'll come around.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's great to hear you're spreading the word! Maybe I can talk to Kira myself and show her how much fun it'll be.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Tess, just a heads up—the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the porch. Can I count on you for a tool shift?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh yeah, I heard about the switch! Absolutely, I can do a tool shift on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks Tess! I'll put you down for the afternoon slot then.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Rosa, I'm sorry, I keep forgetting—what exactly are we fixing at the repair drive? I think I need to find my toolbox first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Oren, I'm not sure about your toolbox, but the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center now. Could you check if you have a socket set for Leo?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sunday? Oh dear, I had Saturday in my head. A socket set for Leo... I think I might have one, but I'll have to dig through my garage to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Uli, did you hear the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sunday... I suppose that works. I'll try to make it if I can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, it'll be good to have you there. I'm bringing a broken lamp and a wobbly chair.
